packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.name: Adapter-kit package
packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.description: Marks the adapter toolkit as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.name: Broker interface
packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.description: The shared shape every broker connection must follow.

packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.name: Channel interface
packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.description: The shared shape every outbound message channel must follow.

packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.description: Builds the labelled, escaped blocks of outside content kept out of the system's own instructions, each with one of a fixed set of trust labels.

packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.name: Request budgeting
packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.description: Keeps each model request within its size limits, dropping whole exchanges and saying in place what was left out.

packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.name: Adapter interfaces
packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.description: Collects the shared shapes outside-service connections follow.

packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.name: Market interface
packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.description: The shared shape every market-data source must follow.

packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.name: Model error classifying
packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.description: Works out why a model request failed and turns it into a stable reason the router can act on.

packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.name: Model interface
packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.description: The shared shape every AI model connection must follow.

packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.name: Adapter registry
packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.description: Keeps the set of available connections, looked up by name.

packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.name: Secret-store interface
packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.description: The shared shape a secret store must follow.

packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.name: Token counting
packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.description: Estimates a request's size offline, using cached token data.

packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.name: Model message types
packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.description: Defines the shapes of a model message, a tool call and a tool definition.

packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.name: Voice interfaces
packages/adapter-kit/src/lonora_adapter_.description: The shared shapes for speech-to-text, text-to-speech and the live voice connection.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/__.name: Adapters package
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/__.description: Marks the outside-service connections as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.name: Brokers package
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.description: Marks the broker connections as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.name: Broker manager
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.description: Keeps the owner's broker connections and hands out the right one.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.name: MetaApi discovery
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.description: Shared setup for reaching MetaApi over both its history and live connections.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.name: MetaApi connection handling
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.description: Owns the MetaApi connection and honours its rate limits; it never retries a money request here.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.name: MetaApi account setup
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.description: Creates, starts, stops, updates and removes trading accounts at MetaApi.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.name: MetaApi broker
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.description: The full connection to the MetaApi broker: reading accounts, quotes and candles and sending orders.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.name: Broker data normalizing
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.description: Turns the broker's raw figures — quotes, candles, accounts, positions and session times — into Lonora's own consistent shapes.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.name: Relayed broker
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.description: Lets the main server read a broker account through the always-on worker, which actually holds the connection.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.name: Simulation broker
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/br.description: A demo broker that executes against explicitly imported market snapshots, kept in the database.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ch.name: Channels package
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ch.description: Marks the outbound-channel connections as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ch.name: Phone push sender
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ch.description: Sends push notifications to the owner's phones through Expo, in batches.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ch.name: Webhook sender
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ch.description: Sends messages to an outside address as a webhook.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ch.name: In-app notifier
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ch.description: Delivers a notification into the app over the live connection.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ma.name: Market adapters package
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ma.description: Marks the market-source connections as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ma.name: Broker as market source
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ma.description: Reads market data straight from a broker connection.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ma.name: Recorded market (test)
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ma.description: A test market source that replays recorded data.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ma.name: News feed reader
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/ma.description: Reads RSS and Atom news feeds safely through the public web client.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mc.name: AI-connection package
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mc.description: Marks the outside-AI-connection code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mc.name: Outside AI connector
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mc.description: Connects to an outside AI connection and calls its tools.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mc.name: Connection sign-in
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mc.description: Handles the sign-in handshake for an outside AI connection.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mc.name: Connection tool policy
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mc.description: Decides which of an outside AI connection's tools may be used, and never trusts one that could trade or move money.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mc.name: Connection transport
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mc.description: Carries the requests to and replies from an outside AI connection.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mo.name: Model adapters package
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mo.description: Marks the AI-model connections as one package; holds no logic of its own.
